WhiteLabel.title: White Label
WhiteLabel.description: Configure your identity without changing NGO records or compliance workflows.
WhiteLabel.publishConfirm: Publish this saved draft for all users in your tenant?
WhiteLabel.draftSaved: Draft saved. Published branding is unchanged.
WhiteLabel.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved branding changes. Leave without saving?
WhiteLabel.failed: Unable to complete the branding action.
WhiteLabel.entitlementHelp: White-label configuration is preserved but inactive under the current subscription. Contact the platform administrator for entitlement.
WhiteLabel.suspendedHelp: Branding is suspended by the platform administrator. Your configuration and history are preserved.
WhiteLabel.identityHelp: Provider branding is separate from the legal identity of each client NGO. Official statutory documents are never modified.
WhiteLabel.previewHelp: Draft preview only. Changes are not visible to normal users until published.
WhiteLabel.sampleEmailBody: Your compliance deadline is approaching. Review the evidence and assigned owner.
WhiteLabel.dropHelp: Drag an image here or browse files.
WhiteLabel.uploadValidation: PNG, JPG or WEBP; maximum {max} MB. Favicon must be square.
WhiteLabel.assetDraftHelp: Asset uploaded to your draft. Save and publish to make it active.
WhiteLabel.hexValidation: Use a six-digit HEX value such as #218838.
WhiteLabel.contrastWarning: Publishing is blocked by low text contrast:
WhiteLabel.contrastHelp: Text must have at least 4.5:1 contrast on the surface/background. Button text colors are chosen automatically for readability.
WhiteLabel.senderHelp: The From address remains the platform's provider-verified sender. Only sender name and reply-to can be customized.
WhiteLabel.emailLocaleHelp: Emails combine shared templates, user locale, published branding and variables, with tenant-default and English fallback.
WhiteLabel.reportHelp: Only system-generated reports are branded. Provider and client NGO identities remain separate; CSV exports stay data-oriented.
WhiteLabel.domainHelp: Add a public subdomain, configure the TXT ownership record and CNAME routing, then verify. Unverified domains never become active.
WhiteLabel.disableDomainConfirm: Disable this custom domain? Existing users should use the platform domain.
WhiteLabel.sslHelp: Your deployment provider must bind the domain and provision/renew its certificate. Activation requires verified ownership, configured routing and a valid HTTPS certificate.
WhiteLabel.copyHelp: Clipboard is unavailable. Select and copy the displayed value.
WhiteLabel.brandLocaleHelp: Fallback: user locale → tenant default locale → base tagline. Language settings remain independent of branding.
WhiteLabel.historyDraftHelp: Historical version loaded into your local draft. Save and publish to activate.
WhiteLabel.removeAssetConfirm: Remove this unused asset? Active published assets cannot be removed.
WhiteLabel.discardConfirm: Discard unpublished changes and return to the active configuration? History is retained.
WhiteLabel.resetConfirm: Create a default branding draft? The published version will remain active until you publish.
WhiteLabel.platformDescription: Manage tenant entitlements, unsafe branding and verified domains. Every action is audited.
WhiteLabel.platformConfirm: Apply this platform action? It may change brand or domain availability for this tenant.
